b1201.q: Do I need API keys to use GenNal?
b1201.a: No. GenNal runs the CLIs you've already signed in to.

b1202.a: Two views of one app. Switching never restarts anything.

b1203.a: First-party and offline. Installing one just decides whether it shows.

b1204.q: Can I search and replace across the whole project?
b1204.a: Yes — match case, whole word, regex, include and exclude globs.

b1205.q: How does the prompt generator work?
b1205.a: Rough idea in, structured prompt out — from the sparkle or ⌘K.

b1206.q: Can GenNal write commit messages and push for me?
b1206.a: Yes. Generate commit message, then Commit & push in Environment.

b1207.a: It reads your local Claude Code and Codex files.

b1208.q: Does GenNal upload my code to its own servers?
b1208.a: No. Prompts go only to the provider CLI you choose.

b1209.q: Can I add a model that is not listed?
b1209.a: Yes — Add model, or an entry in models.json.

b1210.q: Which platforms and devices are supported?
b1210.a: Windows 10/11, macOS 11+, 64-bit Linux — and your phone with GenNal Remote.
